description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Kanapathippillai Tharumalingam from the Administrative District of Jaffna and Mr. Vallipuram Kamaleswaran from the Administrative District of Mullaitivu as the members of the Northern Province Provincial Council and Mr. Arthur Chamara Sampath Dasanayake Don as a member of Uva Province Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Badulla and Mr. Athuldura Arachchige Nandana Pathmakumara as a member of the Western Province Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Kalutara
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in Provincial Councils due to resignations and members being elected to Parliament. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of elected members to fill these vacancies under the Provincial Councils Elections Act. The content focuses on electoral procedures and results declarations, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7).
